title: Animated Data Table
subtitle: Sort, filter, select and reorder rows that glide into place.

descriptions.staggerRows: Rows appear one after another when the table loads or changes.
descriptions.staggerCells: Cells inside each row also appear one after another.
descriptions.numberAnimation: How numbers change: roll digit by digit, count up, or switch instantly.
descriptions.duration: How long each animation takes, in seconds.
descriptions.stagger: Delay between each row or cell appearing, in seconds.
descriptions.rowHighlight: How the hover highlight moves between rows: slides, fills from the top, or none.
descriptions.rowHighlightColor: Colour of the row highlight: soft grey or the theme's primary colour.
descriptions.rollingText: Header and button labels roll to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.showStatusFilter: Shows the status filter above the table.
descriptions.highlightTotal: Highlights the total figure in the footer.
descriptions.showPagination: Splits the rows into pages with next and previous buttons.
descriptions.selectable: Adds a checkbox to every row.
descriptions.showSelectAll: Shows the select-all checkbox in the header. Needs Row checkboxes on.
descriptions.selectMark: Mark shown in a selected row's checkbox: checkmark or filled circle. Needs Row checkboxes on.
descriptions.showActionBar: Shows a floating action bar when rows are selected. Needs Row checkboxes on.
descriptions.dragMode: Lets you drag rows up and down to reorder them.
descriptions.showStatusBadges: Shows status as coloured badges instead of plain text.
descriptions.expandable: Rows open to reveal a preview underneath.
descriptions.removable: Adds a button to delete a column.
descriptions.addable: Adds a button to add new rows.
descriptions.textAlign: Alignment of the text in the cells.
descriptions.bordered: Draws a border around the table.
descriptions.showHeaderBorder: Draws a line under the header row.
descriptions.stickyHeader: Keeps the header in view while the rows scroll.
descriptions.expandFullTable: Grows the table to show every row instead of scrolling inside it.
descriptions.height: Height of the table, as a percentage of the viewport. Ignored when Expand full table is on.
descriptions.stickyFooter: Keeps the last row pinned at the bottom while the rows scroll.
descriptions.loadingSkeleton: Shows shimmering placeholders for a moment before the rows appear.

themeDescription: Colour palette for the table, its menus and the action bar. Selected rows and primary buttons take its primary colour.
